_meta.why: Departments and staff as Nextcloud keeps them: the groups as folders with their member counts, a group's members with their function, roles, e-mail and today's presence. Read through the library's users entity source and groups folder source; dossiq keeps no copy. No group is named here: which groups an organisation has is the instance's, not the app's. The tree comes from the organisation roles (organisatieRol: its Nextcloud group and its parent role), so the departments nest as the organisation set them up.

config._selectableNote: Board DqAfdelingen: no selection column. Staff come from Nextcloud and nothing acts on several of them at once here.
config._showCountNote: Board DqAfdelingen: no count line under the title; the folder heading already says how many staff.
config.headerMeta: from Nextcloud groups, with function and absence
config._headerButtonsNote: Board DqAfdelingen: Downloaden in the header downloads the staff the list shows as CSV (the users source's columns).
